opinions.text:
Ct. Crim. App. Tex. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, pre*1015sented to Justice Scalia, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Ginsburg, Justice Breyer, Justice Soto-mayor, and Justice Kagan would grant the application for stay of execution.
